board.name: Customer.io
board.content:
Customer.io is an AI-powered customer engagement platform designed for organizations to create personalized customer journeys that engage, convert, and scale. Orchestrate messages across all channels, including email, in-app, SMS, push, and webhooks.

 

Over 9,000+ companies, including Notion, LESMILLS+, and Angi, rely on Customer.io to power their messaging needs.
